newsitem.title: USA: Putnam Dividend Income to redeem pfd shares.
newsitem.headline: Putnam Dividend Income to redeem pfd shares.

text.p: Putnam Investment Management Inc said Friday that it approved the redemption on July 21 of all of the outstanding money market preferred shares of the Putnam Dividend Income Fund.
Putnam Investment Management said it recommended the redemption because it would benefit the fund's common shareholders in the market conditions expected to prevail over the near term.
Putnam Investment Management said it expects to recommend that the monthly per share dividend be reduced on the fund from $0.065 to $0.0575 for the August dividend.
Putnam Investment Management is a money management firm with over $190 billion in equity and fixed income investments.
